quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: Stopping distance does NOT depend on:

options.text: Your vehicle's tire condition and type.

questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed.

questions.question: You drive defensively when you:

options.text: Keep one car length between you and the car ahead.
Look only at the car directly in front of you.
Keep your eyes moving to watch for hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your eyes moving to watch for hazards.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means looking ahead for hazards. Staring only at the road in front of you is dangerous. Scan ahead and stay alert to vehicles around you.

questions.question: For drivers age 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: For drivers age 21 or older, the legal limit is 0.08 percent BAC. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: A solid yellow arrow traffic signal means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
The same thing as a yellow circular traffic light.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.
A green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same thing as a yellow circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow light. Slow down and prepare for a red light.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off fog and shine back into your eyes.

questions.question: When stopping on snow or ice with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), you should:

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal firmly.
Avoid braking and let the car slide to a stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal firmly.
questions.explanation: With ABS, press the brake pedal firmly on snow or ice. The ABS pumps the brakes faster than you can.

questions.question: When changing lanes, check your blind spots by:

options.text: Using both inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: Which is NOT a safe night driving practice?

options.text: Know that tinted windows reduce visibility at night.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking at oncoming headlights causes your eyes to adjust. After the vehicle passes, your eyes need time to adjust back, leaving you nearly blind.

questions.question: What best ensures safety when backing your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before getting in the driver's seat.
Turn up the car radio to alert people around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before getting in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Before backing up, walk to the back of the vehicle to check for children and small objects. It is hard for drivers to see behind their vehicles.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an upcoming corner. You must yield to:

options.text: Oncoming vehicles that are also turning left.
Pedestrians on the sidewalk waiting for a walk signal.

questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other vehicles that have a green light.

questions.question: You cannot park within ____ of a crosswalk.
questions.explanation: You cannot park within 25 feet of a crosswalk or intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it is a sign that says something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make U-turns.

questions.question: Your body removes approximately:
questions.explanation: On average, your body processes about one alcoholic drink per hour. How fast alcohol affects you depends on many things: how much you drink, how quickly you drink it, your weight, whether you have eaten, and your overall health.

questions.question: You are about to exit the interstate. When should you slow down?

options.text: About halfway through the deceleration lane.
As you approach the deceleration lane.
Right when you enter the deceleration lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right when you enter the deceleration lane.
questions.explanation: Keep your speed steady until you enter the deceleration lane. Then slow down to match the speed shown on the exit ramp sign.

questions.question: The most important thing to remember about speed and curves is:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit as you enter the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle may be hard to turn if you are going too fast. Slow down before entering a curve to keep control of your vehicle.

questions.question: Stopping completely, yielding to traffic and pedestrians, and then going through the intersection when safe describes:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, turn into:
questions.explanation: When you turn, go from your lane into the first available legal lane. This is true even when turning from a two-way street onto a one-way street.

questions.question: After stopping, you can turn left at a red light only if:

options.text: You are on a two-way street turning onto a two-way street.
You are on a one-way street turning onto another one-way street.
You yield to all other traffic at the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a one-way street turning onto another one-way street.
questions.explanation: After stopping completely, you can turn left at a red light only when you are on a one-way street turning onto another one-way street. Make sure there are no signs that prohibit this turn.

questions.question: You reach an intersection blocked by traffic ahead. You should:

options.text: Go slowly until the traffic moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front of you.
Stay out of the intersection until you can completely pass through.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can completely pass through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if traffic is backed up and you cannot drive all the way through. Wait for traffic ahead to clear so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text on it to confirm this is a no passing zone.

questions.question: How should you treat railroad crossings?

options.text: Safe to cross, since trains rarely come.
Safe places to park your car.
A place where you must stop.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Always look and listen for trains coming from either direction. Follow all signs, signals, and flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and turn the wheels:
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn wheels away from the curb. When parking uphill without a curb or parking downhill, turn wheels toward the curb or road edge.

questions.question: When driving on an interstate with traffic entering from on-ramps on your right, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Watch for on-ramps on interstate highways. When safe, move left to give vehicles room to enter from the on-ramps on your right.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.
